governance.title: Request-controlled content
governance.body: This library is for viewing and searching. To create or change a regulation, start a compliance configuration request. Approved versions stay unchanged until that request is approved and published.

access.title: Read only for your role
access.body: You can view the library here. Creating, amending and publishing need a compliance or form admin role, enforced by row-level security.
access.unverifiedBody: Your configuration permissions could not be verified. Writes are disabled — reload the page to retry.

degraded.title: The regulation library could not be read
degraded.body: Nothing is shown as zero. The library is unavailable, which is not the same as empty. Your session and navigation still work.

authorities.heading: Issuing authority
authorities.caption: Grouped on the authority recorded against each regulation. There is no authority registry to reconcile these against.

table.caption: Governed regulations, with the clause, inspection-item and violation footprint recorded against each.

footprint.incomplete: No clauses recorded — this regulation cannot be published as it stands

empty.title: No regulations recorded yet
empty.body: The library read succeeded and returned nothing. Regulations are the parents of every inspection item — the first one is created through a configuration request.
empty.filteredBody: The library itself is not empty. Clear the search, authority or lifecycle filter.

workspace.locked: This is the approved version. Creating or changing anything here goes through a compliance configuration request.
workspace.viewRequest: View the request that published this
workspace.unavailable: {records} could not be read — this is not a claim that there are none
workspace.notFoundBody: No regulation in your access scope has this identifier. It may have been superseded or deactivated.

overview.absent: Description, inspection type and a last-modified timestamp are not stored against a regulation, so they are not shown. Legal source is recorded per clause, not per regulation.

items.caption: Inspection items under the clauses of this regulation, with the responses they accept and the violation each response raises.
items.emptyBody: The read succeeded and returned none. No item is mapped to a clause of this regulation.

violations.caption: Violations recorded against the clauses of this regulation.
violations.emptyBody: The read succeeded and returned none. No violation is recorded against a clause of this regulation.
violations.footnote: Violations attach to a clause, not to an inspection item. Raised by lists the items whose response mapping names this violation code.

penalties.caption: Penalties mapped to the violations of this regulation.
penalties.emptyBody: The read succeeded and returned none. No penalty is mapped to a violation of this regulation.
penalties.footnote: One violation carries at most one penalty mapping. An empty amount means no monetary value is recorded — it does not mean zero.

versions.caption: Published versions of this regulation.
versions.emptyBody: No governed version has been published for this regulation.
versions.footnote: Every version here was published through an approved configuration request. No version is inferred.

audit.label: Change history
audit.emptyBody: The read succeeded and returned no events for this regulation.
audit.footnote: Recorded events only. An empty history means nothing was logged, not that nothing happened before logging began.

record.attachmentsNote: Files are held in private storage, checksummed, and opened through short-lived signed links.
record.attachmentsUnknown: The attachment list could not be read for this version — this is not a claim that there are none.
record.attachmentsEmptyBody: The read succeeded and returned none. No source document is filed against this version.
record.clausesNote: Every clause here carries at least one mapped inspection item.
record.clausesUnknown: The clause list could not be read for this version — this is not a claim that there are none.
record.clausesEmptyBody: The read succeeded and returned none. A regulation with no clauses cannot be published as it stands.
record.unmappedWarning: {count} clause(s) carry no mapped inspection item. Publication is blocked until every clause maps to one.
record.lifecycleNote: Deactivation applies at once and is logged. It also blocks future use of the inspection items, violations and penalties beneath this regulation, while past versions are kept. Reactivating does not reactivate them.

lifecycle.reasonHint: Recorded against the change and shown in the audit history.
lifecycle.cascaded: Cascaded to {items} inspection items, {violations} violations and {penalties} penalties.
lifecycle.denied: You are not authorised to change regulation lifecycle state.
lifecycle.notFound: The regulation no longer exists or is outside your scope.
lifecycle.providerError: The lifecycle change could not be completed. Retry safely.
